scope: Read-only source and retained cost-evidence audit. No new execution, outcomes, CP7 reads, optimization code or edits to active worktrees.

call_map.detail: Replay the frozen root with ordinary forward; switch back to declared search mode; score root once; run E, A, D selection sequentially within a worker; evaluate paired worlds. Each policy role is a fork, with separate sampling streams.

Each simulation lawfully samples a world, resets role RNGs, chooses UCB actions along information-history nodes, expands at most one node, then uses policy rollout; every engine transition charges the same meter.

Sample one world per round and clone per root candidate. A continues plain play; D first samples a focal policy action, rescores the unchanged decision for candidate probabilities, and runs inner candidate continuations.
Forced single-option choices already bypass policy and RNG. Other choices call select_fast_session_v1; apply performs engine step and optional labels/history.
Encode actor-visible decision into reusable owned encoding buffers; tensorize V3/V4; validate and run policy/value network; sample logits with the declared role RNG.

V3/V4 rebuild projections, feature vectors and canonical JSON scratch per call; state hashes already use multi-buffer SHA-512 and exact prefix cache. New DigestBatch is constructed per state digest invocation.

Validated forward builds intermediate vectors, uses transposed weights and shared state-prefix sums; PR206 adds fixed-width register accumulation/AVX2 and opt-in approximate tanh. Value head is always computed.
Build actor-visible V4 observation/menu, normalize permitted handles/counters/order, serialize canonical bytes, hash with parent history. This is separate from tensorizer canonical JSON.

retained_profile.completion_observed: claim.out exit_code=0; prof-r1.log two item completion lines and exit 0
limits: Two engineering roots, both A48 opponent; full transition caps but not a representative population estimate.
These are per-worker elapsed scopes under two-core concurrency, not isolated CPU-cycle shares and not job wall time.
Profile predates PR206; use it to locate work, not as current post-PR206 percentages.
INFER contains encode, tensorize, network forward and action sampling. It is not pure neural arithmetic.
The real profile log loads actor-relative-v7 policies. PR206's finer phase fixture is V3-only and cannot establish the same split for these V4 roots.

timer_audit.nesting: Existing category wrappers are not nested with one another. Sampler internally includes cloning, so do not describe session_clone as all cloning cost or add separate conceptual clone estimates. Rounded category sums leave uninstrumented residual and timer overhead.

already_applied.detail: Exact transposed-weight SIMD-friendly accumulation, shared state half of action scorer, V3/V4 multi-buffer state hashes/prefix cache and streaming canonical observation JSON.
Exact fixed-width register-held sums and AVX2 dispatch; search-only opt-in approximate tanh; frozen-root replay remains ordinary forward.
Forced-action inference/RNG bypass; persistent per-role policy encoders; E tree reuse across simulations; no extra neural scoring for UCB-selected focal tree actions.

candidates.name: Persistent tensorization and forward scratch
candidates.reason: The measured dominant policy pipeline still creates full tensor/intermediate vectors each call. Reuse per-role buffers without changing numerical order or contracts.
candidates.limit: No allocation cost share or speedup measured in retained real-root profiles; existing owned encoding buffers do not make all tensor/forward work allocation-free.

candidates.name: Measure residual tensorization versus forward after PR206
candidates.reason: Existing phase splitter is test-only V3 fixture. Need V4 real-root phase split to choose between further forward work and canonicalization/hash construction.
candidates.limit: Do not extrapolate fixture 0.50ms or hot-cache 6% into a real-root speed guarantee or conclusion about GPU batching.

candidates.name: Reuse D sampled-action logits
candidates.reason: D samples using focal policy, then same-model scorer re-encodes/re-scores the same unchanged session. Carry sampled logits/probabilities into improve while preserving exactly one RNG draw, candidate order and charged transitions.
candidates.limit: Only about 0.397% of D policy calls and 0.134% of all selection calls in this cohort. This is not the largest lever; calls may have different costs.

candidates.name: Optimize canonical key construction only if residual warrants
candidates.reason: E canonicalization is measured at 3.145% of selection wall in retained roots, using Value trees, sorting and serialization.
candidates.limit: At this profile share eliminating the entire category yields only about 1.0325x E selection. Preserve ordered zones, canonical bytes and information-history identity; no unordered-state approximation implied.

smallest_additional_profile.reason: Retained real-root scopes already establish the policy decision pipeline as dominant.
smallest_additional_profile.if_implementation_is_later_assigned: Use an engineering-only opt-in phase split at the common FrozenPlayPolicy scoring entry, covering both V3/V4 and direct D rescoring. Split encoding, tensorization, validated forward, sampling and any cache/allocation counts; retain arm attribution and an explicit residual. Reuse existing engineering roots and fixed transition budgets with actual post-PR206 binary, unchanged seeds, ordinary/fast mode declared. Sampling instrumentation can limit observer overhead. No new simulation or build was performed in this audit.
smallest_additional_profile.preserve: Existing formal records and active runs remain untouched; use supported guarded allocation for any future timing.
